items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: He and I dated a couple of young ladies together before I got married. And in fact he was instrumental in me working for the Informa Sentinel.

ctx.x: Did this kind of reflect Elgin's personality as to who he was? Did some of Elgin come out of it?

Well, Elgin was a very flamboreant writer. He was a big person, about six feet two, a six feet three weight, about two hundred and thirty or forty pounds. Very nice man in his day. Very handsome person. He and I dated a couple of young ladies together before I got married. And in fact he was instrumental in me working for the Informa Sentinel. Right. When you first came out of service. And so like I said, he was trying to cultivate a new agenda for the actions of people in open public. But like I said, when you…
I'm thinking how can you sit still?
